contracts: (Validation passes only when evidence is appended and all frozen historical paths, membership, and bytes are unchanged.) AND (Validation succeeds only when all six Matrix Cases have both Stable and Candidate attributed records.)
selector_intents: Emit evidence outside the declared write boundary; scoped validation rejects the out-of-bound path.
Mutate or remove a frozen historical artifact in the repair fixture; validation detects hash or membership drift.
Select an evidence fixture missing a case or subject attribution and require the validator to reject it.
